verdict.rationale: Elicit's first-party export docs cover all three formats in the story: Research Reports export to PDF or Word on any plan, tables export to CSV and Excel, and the Library and certain source tables export as RIS/BIB for Zotero, Mendeley or EndNote. The one caveat is that Systematic Review table export is limited to Pro, Scale and Enterprise plans. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of export quality, and plan gating on Systematic Review table exports.

support.subject: As a researcher, I can export results to common formats, including documents, spreadsheets, and reference-manager files

citations.quote: Research Reports can be exported as a PDF or Word file, regardless of which Elicit plan you subscribe to.
Tables can be exported in CSV and Excel format. Certain tables of sources can be exported as RIS or BIB files.
Your Elicit Library can be exported as a .ris file, which you can import into Zotero, Mendeley, EndNote, or another reference manager.
Export to RIS, CSV, BIB, PDF and DOCX
